title: DAILY BENEFITS
OF THE LORD
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: soft sunlight streaming through office window
dust motes dancing in midday light
empty wooden desk with open journal
calm shadows moving across a wall
golden hour light hitting a glass of water

scenes.a: That persistent worry about your unfinished tasks will still be there after you finish praying.
scenes.sub: GRACE IN THE MIDDLE OF THE DAY

scenes.a: Instead, choose to lift your tired heart to the One who sustains every single breath.
Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation.
Father, thank You for the grace that overflows in this quiet hour of the afternoon.
Teach me to see Your hand in the mundane details that currently fill my heavy schedule.
Renew my spirit with the hope of Your salvation as I return to these remaining hours.
